speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for coming in; please describe the swelling in your right knee, including when it started and if you have noticed any pain or stiffness. Additionally, could you elaborate on your family history of similar joint problems?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Not yet; I need to know if the swelling involves all four spaces of the knee and whether it has ever been aspirated, as well as if the family member had a "butterfly" deformity of the patella, which points toward Multicentric Carpotarsal Osteolysis.
